one_line: Visionary yet ruthless Sultan of Delhi who launched bold experiments in capital relocation, currency and frontier campaigns.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, tall and lean but broad-shouldered, with a disciplined, wiry build
appearance.face: oval face with a sharp jawline, wheatish-brown North Indian complexion, intense deep-set dark eyes, straight prominent nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, and a calm but piercing, calculating default expression
appearance.hair: straight, dark brown-black hair kept short and tidy under a deep green, slightly conical cloth turban wrapped low with a narrow gold band at the base and a subtle fold draping toward the left temple
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length, long-sleeved quilted jama (robe) in rich deep green cotton with a subtle diamond quilting pattern, fastened diagonally from right shoulder to left hip with small brass buttons, over a cream-coloured, high-collared under-tunic visible at the neckline and cuffs; a wide dark maroon leather belt with a simple brass buckle cinches his waist, holding a small utilitarian leather pouch; below, he has loose straight cream cotton paijama trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather riding boots; over the jama hangs a sleeveless, hip-length dark maroon cloth overcoat edged with narrow gold trim, suggesting courtly rank without excessive ornament; he wears a modest gold ring on his right hand and simple gold-stud earrings, and a plain dark brown wool shawl is draped back from his shoulders, fluttering slightly to suggest motion when he walks.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved single-edged Indo-Persian sword (talwar) with a dark steel blade, a simple brass cross-guard, and a wrapped dark brown leather grip, sheathed in a plain dark brown scabbard hanging on his left side from his belt so he can rest one hand on the hilt.

ref_desc: Muhammad bin Tughlaq is a tall, lean Sultan with wheatish skin, intense eyes, short beard, deep green quilted jama, cream trousers, maroon belt and overcoat, brown leather boots, green turban, and a simple brass-hilt talwar at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Muhammad bin Tughlaq as a tall, lean Delhi Sultan: an oval-faced, wheatish-brown man in his mid-30s with intense deep-set eyes, straight nose, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, wearing straight dark brown-black hair kept short under a deep green conical cloth turban with a narrow gold band. Show him in a knee-length deep green quilted jama with subtle diamond stitching, long sleeves and diagonal brass-button fastening, a cream under-tunic at neck and cuffs, a sleeveless hip-length dark maroon overcoat edged with thin gold trim, a wide dark maroon leather belt with brass buckle and small pouch, loose cream cotton paijama trousers, and brown leather riding boots. Add a plain dark brown wool shawl pushed back off his shoulders, a modest gold ring on his right hand and simple gold-stud earrings. At his left hip, show his signature slightly curved Indo-Persian talwar with dark steel blade, simple brass cross-guard, wrapped dark brown leather grip, and plain dark brown scabbard. Use deep green, dark maroon, cream, brown leather and gold as the dominant colors, and present him standing calmly with a calculating expression, one hand near the sword hilt, clearly visible from head to toe.
